question: Can topological data analysis followed by a topology-constrained variational autoencoder recover compact, interpretable physical variables from observations without labels?

key_findings.claim: The proposed workflow first estimates Betti numbers and then hand-constructs a latent manifold with matching topology inside a VAE.
key_findings.evidence: Persistent homology is used to count connected components, loops, and voids; those counts determine explicit circle, lemniscate, or sphere constraints added to the VAE loss, while extra Gaussian latent coordinates are encouraged to vanish.

key_findings.claim: On three toy systems, the constrained latent variables form the intended manifold and maintain a one-to-one relation with observations.
key_findings.evidence: A harmonic oscillator maps to a circle, a relative-orbit example to a two-loop lemniscate, and five qubit observables to a sphere; in each case the unused general-purpose coordinate contracts near zero.

key_findings.claim: The approach exposes manifold mismatch but does not automate semantic or topological model selection.
key_findings.evidence: The paper notes that identical Betti numbers need not imply homeomorphism, high-dimensional persistent homology is difficult, and even a topologically valid latent map need not have a simple physical interpretation.

method.core_idea: Separate discovery of a data manifold's topology from learning coordinates on that manifold.
method.mechanism: Estimate low-order Betti numbers from a point cloud, choose an explicit algebraic constraint with those topological features, and add it to a VAE objective so designated topological latent variables lie on the manifold while surplus Gaussian variables collapse.
assumptions: The sampled observations densely and cleanly reveal the physical state manifold to persistent homology.
Low-order Betti numbers identify enough topology to choose a suitable analytic constraint.
A human can translate the estimated topology into a correct and optimizable latent-space equation.

techniques.role: Summarizes connected components, loops, and voids in the observation cloud.
Forces selected latent coordinates onto a manually specified circle, lemniscate, or sphere.
Uses general Gaussian coordinates to test whether additional degrees of freedom are needed.

evaluations.setting: One-dimensional harmonic oscillator with 1,000 synthetic observations
evaluations.metric: Latent geometry, reconstruction, and unused-coordinate magnitude
evaluations.result: Two constrained coordinates lie on a circle with a one-to-one observation map and the extra coordinate approaches zero.

evaluations.setting: Relative orbit with two-loop observation topology
evaluations.result: A hand-coded lemniscate constraint produces two topological coordinates tracing the intended two-loop manifold.

evaluations.setting: Two-level quantum system represented by five observables
evaluations.metric: Sphere constraint and intrinsic coordinate count
evaluations.result: Three constrained coordinates occupy a sphere, corresponding to two independent angular degrees of freedom, while a surplus coordinate collapses.

limitations: Only three small synthetic toy examples with about 1,000 samples are studied; no noisy experimental or high-dimensional benchmark is reported.
Betti numbers do not uniquely determine topology, so the latent constraint remains a human modeling choice.
Persistent-homology estimation and explicit manifold design can become intractable at high intrinsic dimension.
Topology preservation does not guarantee identifiable, unique, or semantically simple physical variables.
failure_modes: Sparse or noisy sampling can create or erase persistence features and produce the wrong latent topology.
Two non-homeomorphic manifolds with the same reported Betti numbers can receive the same incorrect constraint.
A restrictive algebraic manifold can reconstruct training points while distorting interpolation or dynamics.
Rotations and reparameterizations of the same manifold leave physical semantics underdetermined.
reusable_insights: Check latent topology before demanding independent Euclidean factors from an autoencoder.
Separate intrinsic dimension, topology, and semantic identifiability; success on one does not imply the others.
Use surplus latent coordinates as a falsification signal for an underspecified physical state manifold.
Validate learned coordinates on held-out interventions or dynamics, not reconstruction alone.
open_questions: Can the topology and manifold chart be selected end-to-end with uncertainty rather than manually?
How robust is the protocol to finite sampling, observation noise, singularities, and changing topology?
Can dynamics, interventions, or symbolic sparsity identify physically meaningful coordinates among equivalent parameterizations?
Which scalable topological summaries retain enough information beyond Betti numbers?

competitive_landscape.title: Discovering physical concepts with neural networks
competitive_landscape.difference: Iten et al. use communication bottlenecks to find predictive concepts and conservation structure; this paper explicitly estimates and enforces latent topology.

competitive_landscape.title: Extracting Interpretable Physical Parameters from Spatiotemporal Systems using Unsupervised Learning
competitive_landscape.difference: Lu et al. identify PDE parameters through predictive spatiotemporal dynamics and report ground-truth parameter correlation; the reviewed method targets manifold topology in static observation clouds.

competitive_landscape.title: Topological Constraints on Homeomorphic Auto-Encoding
competitive_landscape.difference: de Haan and Falorsi prove necessary topological constraints and analyze homeomorphic encoders; this paper turns that concern into a two-stage physical-variable workflow.

competitive_landscape.title: Hyperspherical Variational Auto-Encoders
competitive_landscape.difference: Davidson et al. replace the Gaussian prior with a von Mises-Fisher hyperspherical latent distribution; this paper uses TDA to motivate problem-specific circle, sphere, or lemniscate constraints.

novelty_assessment: Reviewer inference: topology-aware autoencoders, hyperspherical VAEs, and neural physical-concept discovery all predate this work. The distinct proposal is the explicit TDA-to-constrained-VAE sequence and the use of surplus latent collapse as a degree-of-freedom check, demonstrated only on hand-configured toy manifolds.
reviewer_notes: All seven pages, appendices, examples, training details, and comparison discussion were reviewed. Primary competitor records were checked on 2026-08-23. The paper's term 'unsupervised' should not obscure substantial human input: selecting a constraint from Betti numbers is manual.
